audit_items.proof_trace: _verifyInvestSignature is called before any state mutations on every invest() entry point across all four sale contract types (FixedPrice L89, PreLiquidOpenApplication L74, SealedBidAuction L94) and the function is declared virtual with no override weakening it. The ECDSA recovery check correctly binds the signature to (msg.sender, address(this), block.chainid), preventing cross-contract and cross-chain replay. No alternative invest path bypasses this gate.
